workerResult.summary: Yarrow Yodel Yard: organic-brutalist yodeling game. Mic pitch input (autocorrelation) + built-in yodel voice (hold-to-yodel bend button, pitch slider, A/S/D/F/G keys, Space yodel-break). 5-herb choir (C/D/E/G/A) with sway/bloom/mouth-dance animations and triangle+5th choir tones. Yard score with streaks, perfect bonuses, YODEL x2 wobble multiplier, round phrases, harmony meter, localStorage best. 3 colors (paper/moss/clay)+black/white, responsive to 375px, node --check + ID cross-check clean.
